author_reading.rationale: Same-clock 8-bit pipeline across two submodules where the second takes the clock through a local alias wire; all registers are in one domain so nothing crosses.

labels.rationale: The second module clock is an exact alias of the first module clock. Data, synchronous reset, and output have same-clock timing contracts.

The 8-bit pipeline transfer between u_a (stage_a) and u_b (stage_b, using exact wire alias clk_alias = clk_a) operates entirely within a single clock domain clk_a with synchronous reset rst_ni and complete input/output delay constraints.
